scripted_findings.title: robots.txt blocks 4 AI retrieval agent(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: robots.txt disallows these retrieval/indexing agents: ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, Perplexity-User, PerplexityBot. Blocked paths sampled: ['/', '/contact', '/sport', '/sport/cricket', '/sport/football', '/sport/football/premier-league']. These agents fetch pages in order to answer user questions, so pages they cannot reach cannot be cited. (Note: Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, CCBot, ClaudeBot, GPTBot, Google-Extended are also blocked, but those are training-only agents and do not affect citatio

scripted_findings.title: Brand identity is not anchored to any external profile
scripted_findings.evidence: None of the 12 crawled page(s) declares Organization, LocalBusiness or similar structured data with sameAs links. Without sameAs, an assistant has nothing distinguishing this brand from others sharing the name, which is the standard cause of mistaken identity.

scripted_findings.title: Questions are not paired with self-contained answers on 2 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: https://www.bbc.co.uk/ asks 7 questions in its own headings, e.g. ["What do the critics think of Gary Lineker's new show The Box?", 'Do you know these comedy characters who are never seen or heard?', 'Are plastic food containers safe?'], but nothing on the page pairs each question with a self-contained answer: no FAQPage or Question structured data. An assistant lifting an answer takes the question plus the answer as one unit, and here it has to guess where each answer ends.
